# Total Trailer Services

> Mobile trailer servicing and fault diagnosis based near King's Lynn, Norfolk, UK. The engineer comes to wherever the trailer is kept, with fixed prices from £60. Run by a serving RAF Ground Equipment Engineer with 16+ years in engineering, so bookings are mainly evenings and weekends.

## Key facts

- Business type: sole-trader mobile trailer servicing (no workshop; fully mobile)
- Based: near King's Lynn, Norfolk, England
- Areas covered: King's Lynn, Wisbech, Downham Market, Swaffham, Dereham, Hunstanton, Littleport and villages in between
- Availability: mainly evenings and weekends
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone 07718 046664 (+44 7718 046664), https://wa.me/447718046664, or the contact form at https://totaltrailerservices.com/contact.html
- Website: https://totaltrailerservices.com/

## Services and prices

General service (fixed price, carried out where the trailer is parked):

- Unbraked trailer: £60
- Single axle braked trailer: £80
- Twin axle braked trailer: £100
- Tri axle braked trailer: £120

A general service includes brake servicing (braked trailers), wheel bearing greasing and replacement, lights check, a full safety check, and checking the trailer meets UK road law requirements.

Fault diagnosis and component replacement: quote on request. Covers braking system faults and lighting/wiring faults, plus replacement of worn or failed components.

## Engineer qualifications

- 16+ years in engineering, 10+ years as an RAF Ground Equipment Engineer
- NVQ Level 3 in Engineering Maintenance
- Level 3 Diploma in Heavy Vehicle Maintenance and Repair
- Level 3 Diploma in Engineering Technology
- Level 3 NVQ in Mechanical Manufacturing Engineering
- Level 3 Diploma in Engineering – Maintenance, Installation and Commissioning
